name: codex-security
description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
one_liner: An AI tool that reads through a company's codebase, finds security holes, and helps write the fix for them automatically.
buyer: A startup CTO with no dedicated security team who needs vulnerability scanning before a compliance audit or funding round.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO runs it before a SOC2 audit to find and patch vulnerabilities without hiring a full security firm.
A freelance security consultant uses it to scan client codebases faster, taking on more clients per month.
An agency bakes it into their CI pipeline and sells 'continuous security scanning' as a retainer add-on to web dev clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a flat-fee 'security audit' for small SaaS companies using this plus manual review of the findings
Monthly retainer for continuous scanning and patch review for agencies' client codebases

steal_this: Package it into a one-day paid security audit service for small SaaS startups who can't afford a full pentest.
